rows.en:
(It's all thanks to Saotome-kun and the others,
Ranka-chan... and Sheryl-san too.)

(But no matter how you look at it, Frontier
took way too much damage this time...!)
rows.notes: 'But' carries the preceding row c21094 ('Demo...') into this thought.

rows.en:
(The ship's in tatters, and the ecosystem can't
be sustained anymore... What are we supposed
to do in a situation like this...?)

(The Vajra attacks have pushed Frontier
close to its limit...)
rows.notes: Shared male/female.

rows.en:
(The only way for us to survive
is to take the Vajra's planet for ourselves.)

(Rumors are going around that Ranka betrayed us
and that the S.M.S. crew deserted too, but...)

(As long as we've got Alto and the others
and Sheryl's song, we're sure to be okay!)
My song...
LISTEN TO IIIIIIIT~~~!!!
rows.notes: Sheryl's catchphrase (watashi no uta wo kike) split across two rows: object 'my song' in c21112, verb 'listen' here. Cut at the matching point rather than reordering into the iconic 'Listen to my song!'. Shared male/female.

rows.en: (This is going to be the final battle!)
(Alto, everyone, give it all you've got!!)

(The Vajra...
The Vajra protected Frontier...?)
rows.notes: Shared male/female.

rows.en:
(When Ranka showed up on the Vajra's side,
I thought it was all over, but...)

(So Ranka and the Vajra were both
just being used by Grace.)

(With the Vajra on our side too,
this time we can...!)
rows.notes: Trailing 'kore nara...!' (with this...!) given a subject and modal; the verb stays cut off as in the Japanese.

rows.en: (Gooooooooo!!)
rows.notes: Shared male/female; cheering the pilots on.

rows.en:
(The only way for us to survive
is to take the Vajra's planet for ourselves.)

(Rumors are going around that Ranka-chan
betrayed us and that the S.M.S. crew
deserted too, but...)

(As long as we've got Saotome-kun and the others
and Sheryl-san's song, we're sure to be okay!)
(This is going to be the final battle, after all!)
(Saotome-kun, everyone, give it all you've got!!)

(When Ranka-chan showed up on the Vajra's side,
I thought it was all over, but...)

(So Ranka-chan and the Vajra were both
just being used by Grace.)

(With the Vajra on our side too,
this time we can...!)

(Phew, made it just in time...
I almost ended up late for the entrance ceremony.)

(Starting today, I'm a student at Mihoshi Academy
High School, the Frontier fleet's top school for
specialists. I'd better stay on my toes.)
rows.notes: Bisei Gakuen Koukou: 'Mihoshi Academy High School' (glossary Mihoshi Academy + High School).

rows.en:
(...Wait, this is no time to psych myself up
at the school gate. I've gotta hurry to class!)
rows.notes: Shared male/female.

rows.en:
(Looks like this is the right classroom...
but where should I sit?)
rows.notes: Shared male/female.

rows.en: Whoa, sorry about that.
rows.notes: x6: Alto bumping into the player (name plate shows as PLAYER/none and '??? (woman)' in the parsed script; same speaker). Works for both genders.

rows.en: Whoa.
No, I'm the one who should be sor...
rows.notes: Cut off mid-apology as in the Japanese (gome...).
Shared male/female.

rows.en: (What a pretty girl...)
rows.notes: The player mistakes Alto for a girl.

rows.en: Hey, you're spacing out. Are you really okay?
rows.notes: Alto ('A Girl?' plate). Shared male/female.

rows.en: Y-yeah... I'm fine.
(I can't exactly admit I was staring at her...)

(But why is she wearing
a boys' uniform?)

...Well, now, this is a surprise.
Who'd have thought I'd end up in the same
class as Princess Alto?
rows.notes: Michel ('??? (man)'). Alto-hime = 'Princess Alto' (glossary nickname).

rows.en:
Tch, of all people to share a class with...!
And stop calling me Princess, Michael.
rows.notes: Alto says Mihaeru: glossary en 'Michael Blanc', so 'Michael' (Michel only for Misheru). The parsed name plate for this speaker reads 'Mikhail'; check the plate is set to the same spelling.

rows.en: Aw, don't get so mad, Prin-cess Alto.
rows.notes: Japanese spells out hi-me syllable by syllable to tease.

rows.en:
Even that angry face of yours is lovely...
Honestly, it's a waste for you to be a guy,
Princess Alto.

(...............Huh?! This one's a GUY?!
From every angle, I'd have sworn that
was a gorgeous girl...)
rows.notes: Shared male/female.

rows.en: That attitude of yours is exactly what I...!

Come on, please don't fight in a place like this,
Alto-senpai, Michel-senpai.
rows.notes: Luca ('??? (man)').

rows.en:
Fight? Perish the thought.
Alto and I were just getting a little touchy-feely.
Right, Alto?
rows.notes: sukinshippu (affectionate physical contact) -> 'touchy-feely'.

rows.en: Like I'd know!
rows.notes: shiru ka! = dismissive refusal to play along.

rows.en: Sigh... Okay, I get that you two are close.

Um...
And who might this be...?

Oh right, I haven't even introduced myself yet.
I'm \p.
Nice to meet you all.
Why, thank you for being so polite.

I'm Luca Angeloni.
The pleasure's all mine.

And while I'm at it, Luca skipped a grade,
so he's actually a year younger than us.
(I see... No wonder he doesn't look our age.)

On top of that, he's the rich boy of L.A.I.,
the huge corporation that makes everything
from micromachines to fold engines.
rows.notes: obocchan = rich man's son; 'rich boy' so Luca's protest in c21159 can quote it.

rows.en:
Mmph... Please stop calling me "rich boy,"
Michel-senpai.
Haha, don't pout like that, Luca.

Oh, come to think of it,
I haven't introduced myself either.

Michael Blanc's the name.
Call me Michel, nice and friendly.
rows.notes: Mihaeru Buran -> 'Michael Blanc' (glossary); asks to be called Misheru -> 'Michel'. Name plate here already reads Michel.

rows.en: Nice to meet you, Michel.

Luca-kun, what are you all doing
standing in the classroom doorway?
rows.notes: Nanase ('??? (woman)'); Ruka-kun-tachi = Luca-kun and the others.

rows.en:
N-Nanase-san!
Uh, oh, yes... This person here
is \p-san, and, um...
rows.notes: Shared male/female.

rows.en:
We were just introducing ourselves
to each other, or, well, something like that...

Oh, I see.
Then I'd better introduce myself too.

I'm Nanase Matsuura.
I'm in the Art Course, so I'm in a different
course from you all, but it's nice to meet you.
rows.notes: Geijutsu-ka (art course) is not in the glossary; 'Art Course' by analogy with Pilot Course / Performing Arts Course (geinou-ka). Not the same as geinou-ka.

rows.en: Nice to meet you too, Nanase.
rows.notes: Shared male/female.

rows.en: Hey, Alto, at least introduce yourself.
...Alto Saotome.
Alto-senpai, that's really not enough...
...Nice to meet you.
Nice to meet you too, Alto.
...Yeah.

(I was a little nervous about school life,
but I'm glad I made friends right away...)

(I've gotta keep this up and work hard
to make school life a blast!)

(Phew, made it just in time...
I almost ended up late for the entrance ceremony.)

(Starting today, I'm a student at Mihoshi Academy
High School, the Frontier fleet's top school for
specialists. I'd better stay on my toes.)
No, I'm the one who should be sor...
rows.notes: Cut off mid-apology as in the Japanese.

rows.en: (What a pretty girl...)
Y-yeah... I'm fine.

(I can't exactly admit I was staring at her...
But why is she wearing
a boys' uniform?)

Oh right, I haven't even introduced myself yet.
I'm \p.
Nice to meet you all!

uncertain: c21113: Sheryl's catchphrase split over c21112/c21113 kept in row order ('My song...' / 'LISTEN TO IIIIIIIT~~~!!!') instead of the iconic 'Listen to my song!'.
c21143/c21162: Mihaeru rendered 'Michael' per glossary (Michael Blanc); the parsed name plate for this speaker before the reveal reads 'Mikhail', which disagrees with the glossary.
